results.title: Football Club President Faces £100,000 Court Battle Over Backyard 'Man Cave'
results.description: Football club president Justin Salmon is involved in a legal dispute with neighbour Andrianna Neophytou over a 24ft structure he built in his garden, initially called a 'man cave' and later modified, which she claims breaches their lease and wants demolished.

results.title: Pragyan Ojha appointed men’s chairman of selectors, Ramesh Powar added to panel
results.description: Ramesh Powar has been appointed to the Men’s Selection Committee, with Pragyan Ojha set to chair the panel based on Test experience.
